title: Explore occupations before choosing a path
text: Compare the work itself, typical entry education, work environment and occupational outlook. Occupational statistics describe groups, not an individual hiring probability. Choose a few plausible paths and identify small, practical ways to explore each.

title: Build evidence through deliberate practice
text: Choose one skill connected to a real goal. Build a small artifact, explain your own contribution and document how you checked the result. A completed course alone does not establish proficiency. Ask for feedback, revise the artifact and retain honest evidence of what you did.

title: Evaluate a certification before paying
text: Check whether a credential appears in relevant employer requirements and whether the provider has published prerequisites, fees, renewal rules and exam details. Prefer free foundational practice before paying when the benefit is unclear. A certificate is not a job guarantee or a substitute for required professional licensure.

title: Python tutorial
text: Use the official Python tutorial to practice language fundamentals, data structures, modules and exceptions. Pair reading with a small reproducible project and tests. The tutorial is a learning resource; completing it does not itself certify professional proficiency.

title: SQL practice with SQLBolt
text: Practice filtering, grouping, joins and database changes using interactive SQL lessons. Demonstrate the skill with documented queries against a public or fictional dataset, including checks for duplicates and missing values. Check the provider for current access conditions.

title: OpenIntro statistics
text: Study sampling, uncertainty and statistical reasoning, then apply them to a transparent analysis with assumptions and limitations. Explain what the analysis can and cannot establish. Check the provider for current materials and access options.

title: AWS training and certification
text: Compare official AWS learning paths with the tasks in your target roles. Practice with a small architecture and explain security, reliability and cost decisions. Verify current exam fees, prerequisites and cloud-service charges on the provider site before committing.

title: Microsoft Learn
text: Use official learning paths for relevant Microsoft tools. Choose modules that fit a concrete task and build an artifact that demonstrates it. Distinguish training modules from an earned certification; verify current exam requirements and pricing with Microsoft.

title: CompTIA certification information
text: Compare IT certification objectives with your current foundations and target support, systems or security roles. Review official recommended experience, exam details and renewal conditions. Practice troubleshooting and document diagnostic reasoning before treating an exam as the only preparation.

title: MDN web development learning
text: Practice accessible HTML, CSS, JavaScript and web fundamentals through MDN learning materials. Build and test a small application, explain design decisions and document limitations. Accessibility and clear documentation can make a portfolio easier to review.

title: Management analyst occupational information
text: Explore management-analysis duties and typical occupational entry preparation using BLS information. Practice framing a business problem, comparing options and explaining recommendations with evidence. Do not infer consulting readiness from a degree title alone.

title: Marketing occupational information
text: Use occupational information to understand marketing responsibilities and distinguish experienced management roles from starting positions. A useful practice project can define an audience, a campaign hypothesis, measures and limitations using fictional or public information.

title: Accounting career information
text: Compare accounting duties and education pathways with the work you want to pursue. Use official state-board and credential-provider information for licensure eligibility; degree labels alone cannot establish CPA eligibility. Practice a clearly labeled fictional accounting or audit case.

title: Financial analyst career information
text: Explore analyst responsibilities, occupational education information and possible specializations. Build a transparent financial analysis using public or fictional data and explain assumptions and uncertainty. A career exercise is not personalized investment advice.

title: Project Management Institute certification information
text: Compare project-management learning with the coordination work you want to perform. Verify each credential’s current experience and education prerequisites directly with PMI. A practical artifact can include scope, stakeholders, risks and a retrospective of an actual or fictional project.

title: Engineering occupation overview
text: Compare engineering disciplines through their duties, education and work environments. Choose a discipline-specific design exercise with calculations, assumptions, testing and documentation. Do not infer licensure or authority to practice from a project or degree alone.

title: NCEES engineering exam information
text: Use NCEES and the relevant licensing board to check engineering exam and licensure pathways. Requirements vary by jurisdiction and pathway. Treat official eligibility and exam information as prerequisites to investigate, not a credential the student already holds.

title: Autodesk learning
text: Choose learning materials for the design tools used in relevant roles. Practice with a small documented model or drawing, including constraints, dimensions and validation. Verify software access, training and credential requirements directly with the provider.

title: Nursing occupation information
text: Explore nursing duties, work environment and education pathways through occupational information. Required education and licensure must be checked with official programs and the relevant nursing board. Do not equate interest in healthcare with permission to perform regulated clinical work.

title: CDC public-health training
text: Explore CDC training relevant to public-health interests. Choose a learning activity and explain its application to a public-health question using public or fictional data. Verify current eligibility, continuing-education credit and access on the provider page.

title: NIH clinical research training information
text: Explore NIH clinical-research educational courses and check their intended audience and current availability. Pair learning with a literature-review or research-methods artifact. Course participation does not establish clinical qualification or authorization to work with patients.

title: Health services management occupational information
text: Explore healthcare-management responsibilities and typical preparation. Distinguish management pathways from clinical professions and look for appropriate starting or experienced roles. Practice an operations analysis with fictional information and explicit privacy assumptions.

title: Teaching career information
text: Explore education and training occupations and their typical preparation. Check the relevant jurisdiction and program for credential requirements. A practice artifact can include a lesson plan, an assessment and a reflection on how to evaluate learning.

title: USAJOBS students and graduates
text: Explore official federal student and graduate hiring-path information. Eligibility must be read from the actual announcement and official program rules. Build examples that show the tasks and evidence requested rather than assuming that student status qualifies someone for every program.

title: Purdue OWL writing resources
text: Use writing resources to practice audience, structure, clarity and evidence. Create a concise sample for a specific audience and revise it after feedback. Clearly label fictional work and distinguish your individual contribution from group authorship.

title: Figma learning resources
text: Explore official Figma learning resources for relevant design tasks. Build a small portfolio case study that explains the problem, design choices, feedback and iterations. A polished screenshot alone does not explain usability or individual contribution.

title: Journalism occupational information
text: Explore reporting duties and occupational preparation, then practice with accurate attribution and source verification. A writing portfolio should explain what you reported or produced and how claims were checked. Do not fabricate interviews, sources or publication history.

title: Science occupation overview
text: Compare scientific roles through their work, education and specialization requirements. Practice literature review, experimental design, data interpretation and reproducibility using appropriate public or fictional materials. Training does not imply permission to perform regulated or hazardous laboratory work.

title: NIH research training resources
text: Explore official research-training opportunities and read their eligibility criteria. Identify a research question and create a transparent methods or reproducibility artifact. Separate coursework, proposed research and completed personal contributions.

title: Environmental science occupational information
text: Explore environmental-science responsibilities and occupational preparation. A useful practice artifact can analyze a public environmental dataset with documented quality checks, assumptions and limitations. Verify specialized credential and safety requirements with the appropriate provider.

title: University of Arizona career development
text: Prepare focused questions for an informational conversation and connect them to a career goal. Use university career resources to explore advising, employer events and practical preparation. Do not imply that a contact, event or credential guarantees employment.

title: PostgreSQL tutorial
text: Practice relational data concepts using the PostgreSQL tutorial. Build a reproducible data pipeline or database example with validation, clear schema decisions and documented failure cases. Check software and hosting choices for any charges before deploying.

title: CFA Institute program information
text: Compare official program requirements with your career goal, current foundations and budget. Check current registration requirements, exam fees, experience conditions and ongoing obligations directly with CFA Institute. Exploring a program or passing an exam does not establish that you hold a professional designation.

title: CPA pathway information
text: Use official CPA pathway information and the relevant licensing board to investigate education, examination and experience requirements. Requirements and fees need current verification for the chosen jurisdiction. An accounting degree alone does not establish CPA eligibility or licensure.

title: American Marketing Association certifications
text: Compare official marketing certification learning objectives with the skills in your desired roles. Check the provider’s current eligibility, exam, fees and renewal information. Pair learning with a campaign or research artifact and explain its audience, measures and limitations.

title: ANCC certification information
text: Explore official nursing certification information only in relation to the relevant education, licensure and professional pathway. Verify the current prerequisites, practice requirements, fees and renewal conditions. A career interest or a completed course does not establish eligibility for a nursing credential.

title: ASCP Board of Certification
text: Review official laboratory certification routes and their current education, training and experience requirements. Compare the published pathway with confirmed background details and leave unknown eligibility unresolved. Verify fees and application requirements before making a commitment.

title: ASQ certification information
text: Compare quality-related credential objectives with your intended work and existing evidence. Use official ASQ information to check current prerequisites, examination, costs and renewal rules. Demonstrate relevant methods through a documented improvement or quality-analysis project.

title: SHRM certification information
text: Explore official human-resources certification information and check the provider’s current eligibility, examination and fee requirements. Choose a pathway that fits your target responsibilities. A credential is one development option, not a guarantee of an HR role.

title: Google Career Certificates
text: Compare official certificate learning paths with your career goal and the experience you want to demonstrate. Verify current access, subscription costs, expected effort and regional availability. Build a practical artifact and distinguish course completion from demonstrated proficiency.
